_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Florence Crewe-Jones (1876-1940): Hector Malot's Nobody's Boy (Sans famille, 1916) and Nobody's Girl (En famille, 1922). Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 31); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
